autoware_launch/README.md

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

Usage

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

autoware_launch/README.md

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)

autoware_launch/README.md

autoware_launch

Package Dependencies

Please see <exec_depend> in package.xml.

Usage

You can use the command as follows at shell script to launch *.launch.xml in launch directory.

ros2 launch autoware_launch autoware.launch.xml map_path:=/path/to/map_folder vehicle_model:=lexus sensor_model:=aip_xx1
CHANGELOG

Changelog for package autoware_launch

0.53.0 (2026-10-13)

  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into tmp/bot/bump_version_base

  • refactor(map)!: migrate tier4_map_launch to autoware_map_launch with a separate config package (#1980) Part of #1939 (map item). Splits the map launch stack into unit launchers under autoware_universe_launch/autoware_map_launch and moves its parameter tree into the data-only autoware_map_config, with component_map.launch.xml as the composition root. The resolved launch graph is unchanged. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <<noreply@anthropic.com>>

  • refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package (#1971)

    * refactor(localization)!: migrate tier4_localization_launch to autoware_localization_launch with a separate config package Move the localization launch stack out of the product layer and split its parameter tree into autoware_localization_config. localization.launch.xml resolves every parameter file through localization_config_pkg; the launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): move the localization design modules alongside the localization launch package The localization modules move into autoware_localization_launch/design/module, matching the planning and control layout; the parameter set and the wrapper resolve parameter files from autoware_localization_config.

    * refactor(localization): flatten pose/twist source selection into per-estimator junctions pose_source/twist_source string parsing moves into the product component; localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml take one flag per estimator plus the arbiter's pose_sources list, so a fixed system can pin the junctions directly. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization): restore the module-shaped launch composition localization.launch.xml composes the same instances as Localization.module: the util module (pose initializer and the ndt input downsampling) becomes a sibling group with launch/util/util.launch.xml as the LocalizationUtil counterpart, and cross-module wiring (the arbiter relay input, eagleye standing in for the gnss pose) is resolved at the composition root. The launch graph is unchanged.

    * refactor(localization)!: compose localization from self-contained unit launchers The all-mode entry launchers (localization.launch.xml and pose_twist_estimator.launch.xml) are removed: the launch package ships one launcher per unit, each resolving only its own parameters from localization_config_pkg, and component_localization.launch.xml is the composition root that includes only the units the selected sources need — the perception layout. The unreferenced Tier4LocalizationWrapper design is dropped with its launch entry. The launch graph is unchanged.

    • style(pre-commit): autofix

    * fix(localization): connect the automatic pose initializer in LocalizationUtil Wires the pose initializer state and initialize service to automatic_pose_initializer, whose node design now declares the fixed API names as remap targets.

    * chore(localization): drop the exec_depends the composition root owns autoware_pose_estimator_arbiter and autoware_pose_covariance_modifier are included from component_localization.launch.xml, which autoware_launch declares.

    * docs(launch): drop the stale launch diagrams and retarget the config usage example Both package structure diagrams draw the localization.launch.xml composition this series removes, and the autoware_launch one also draws the simulator wrappers as if the root launcher called the sub launchers. The config package documents the composition root as the place localization_config_pkg is set.

    * fix(localization): resolve stop_check_enabled for every system run mode The stop check belongs to a real vehicle, so any run mode other than online disables it; the value is defined unconditionally so a product run mode outside the in-tree set still resolves.

    * chore(localization): carry the changelog over unedited The recorded entries reference upstream pull requests by their original package name, matching the control, planning and perception migrations. ---------Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci[bot] <66853113+pre-commit-ci[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

  • chore(sync-params): update system params (#1946) Co-authored-by: paulsohn <<11360980+paulsohn@users.noreply.github.com>>

  • feat(autoware_launch): make the dummy vehicle and dummy perception to… (#1966)
